description: Hold a standing planar biped (unitree-g1) upright while a disturbance pushes the torso, then let a torque-limited balance PD controller catch it. Gentle push stays within actuator torque authority and the robot recovers (success, payment); a hard push saturates the actuator, the torso tips past the fall threshold and the robot falls (genuine physics failure, never settled).
Hold the current pose; no forward motion. Always succeeds when paid and proves the bounded/interruptible policy.
